correctness.rationale: Explicit bit coordinates satisfy local two-in/two-out constraint h_ij+v_ij=h_i,j-1+v_i-1,j; row-transfer over 16-bit row states enumerates every toroidal orientation without overlap. A one-face move is permitted iff the four boundary bits are 1100 or 0011, and complements precisely those bits. Fresh independent transfer-state enumeration constructed all 2970 orientations, all 8768 undirected edges, nine flux sectors and 60 singleton states, and ran BFS from every state to reproduce the reported component eccentricity counts and full central pair-distance histogram. Explicit 12-move witness and face-height L1 lower bound are consistent with sharp diameter.

final_claim: For the labelled toroidal C4 square C4 Eulerian orientations under reversal of exactly one directed elementary square, the 2970 configurations yield 8768 undirected move edges, 60 frozen vertices and mobile components 4*140+4*340+990, in nine interior flux sectors. All mobile radii equal 8; diameters are 9 for size140 and 12 for larger. Central size990 sector has exactly two checkerboard metric centers and explicit distance histogram (3648,14112,35904,66064,92224,102304,95680,58579,16992,3632,352,64).
